programs.description: Kavitha, a struggling woman, goes through a difficult time while repaying her brother's debts. Later, she takes up an acting job for a commercial and things change drastically.
Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.
Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.

Pappan, a singer, is given another chance to live by Lord Yama after his death. However, his life takes an interesting turn when the deity gives him the power to enter the bodies of other dead people.
A father realises his mistake after his son, whom he loves dearly, kicks him out of the house. At the time, his daughters decide to help him out despite being neglected.
Four bachelors bravely fight against the injustice meted out towards the villagers. However, they land in trouble when they go up against the evil landlord, Panikkar.
Prasanth is a mechanic and is best friends with Freddy. One day, they come across a girl, whose extended family is chasing her for her inherited wealth, and try to save her.
When a family of four sets out on a road trip, they are accompanied by two girls on their way. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the girls is found dead.
A group of college friends meet after many years for a class reunion. However, due to some unexpected turn of events, several dark secrets are revealed, which changes their lives.
Manjula, a transgender woman in Kerala, faces daily challenges in a conservative society. Her journey of self-acceptance and resilience unfolds against evolving social norms.
Xavier, a stenographer, finds himself terminated after his boss learns that he lied to him for a leave. However, when the boss learns that Xavier is a cancer patient, he regrets his decision.
Joji, a motorcycle enthusiast, is the youngest son of a well-known man named Kora Sahib. When Joji is falsely accused of murder, he tries to prove his innocence with the support of his father.
Roby, a young man, migrates to Las Vegas in hopes of earning a livelihood and starts working at a casino. Things take a turn when he loses his friend's money and struggles with mental health issues.
An old man who depends on his family is not particularly liked due to his irksome habits. It all changes when the family learns that he owns a large rubber estate.
Prathapa Verma, in his will, has bequeathed all his property to his illegitimate son, Alexander. His legitimate son and other relatives struggle to get the power of attorney by killing Alexander.
Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.
Bhargavan, a criminal suffering from panic attacks that hold him back from attacking people, goes to a psychiatrist for treatment.
Ananthan Pilla murders Chacko for being an informer of his illicit business. When the police refuse to file a complaint, Chacko's son approaches a prominent family known as the Uppukandam Brothers.
